capabilities: Open a radial action wheel by holding Shift over a word
Link a word to an existing note or create one, with alias and bulk-mention shortcuts
Toggle bold, italic, highlight, strikethrough, and custom wrappers
Extract a passage into a new note that links back with a source property
Shorten text offline or via a local Ollama model, with an editable preview
extras: Desktop only (relies on mouse and Shift); requires Obsidian 1.14.4+; Reading view unsupported; the wheel doesn't open inside rendered tables, embeds, or math in Live Preview; the plugin is listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Common word-level actions like linking, formatting, or defining a term require moving the cursor and navigating menus, interrupting writing.

relations.evidence: Optionally, a local AI (Ollama) can rewrite it instead
Define sends the word or phrase you clicked to Wikipedia
and Wiktionary (en.wiktionary.org), to show its summary and definitions

summary: Hover action wheel that opens over a word when Shift is held, offering linking, formatting, extracting, defining, and shortening.
